title.es: Modales en el pasado: usos completos

objective: Al terminar usas needn't have, didn't need to, could have, should have, might have y ought to have para hablar de lo innecesario, lo posible y los reproches en el pasado.

warmup.prompt_es: 'No hacía falta que vinieras', 'podías haberme avisado', 'deberías haber ido'. Los modales del pasado expresan arrepentimiento, crítica y posibilidades que no ocurrieron.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: I needn't have taken an umbrella. It didn't rain after all.
lines.es: No hacía falta que cogiera paraguas. Al final no llovió.

lines.speaker: Jon
lines.text: You didn't need to take one, but it was sensible. I didn't take mine and got soaked last week.
lines.es: No necesitabas cogerlo, pero fue sensato. Yo no cogí el mío y me empapé la semana pasada.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: You should have checked the forecast. It said rain on Tuesday.
lines.es: Deberías haber mirado la previsión. Decía lluvia el martes.

lines.speaker: Jon
lines.text: I know, I ought to have. I could have borrowed one from Maria, too.
lines.es: Lo sé, debí hacerlo. También podría haberle pedido uno a María.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Speaking of Maria, she should have been here by now. She might have forgotten.
lines.es: Hablando de María, ya debería haber llegado. Quizá se olvidó.

lines.speaker: Jon
lines.text: She can't have forgotten; I reminded her yesterday. She could have been held up by traffic.
lines.es: No puede haberse olvidado; se lo recordé ayer. Podría haberse retrasado por el tráfico.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: You needn't have reminded her. She's very reliable.
lines.es: No hacía falta que se lo recordaras. Es muy fiable.

lines.speaker: Jon
lines.text: True. At least I didn't need to drive; I came by train. I would have been late otherwise.
lines.es: Cierto. Al menos no tuve que conducir; vine en tren. De lo contrario habría llegado tarde.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Look, there she is! She might have told us she was coming on a bike!
lines.es: ¡Mira, ahí está! ¡Podría habernos dicho que venía en bici!

md_es: **Modales del pasado: resumen**
| Estructura | Significado | Ejemplo |
| **should / ought to have + participio** | reproche o arrepentimiento (no se hizo) | *You **should have called**.* |
| **shouldn't have + participio** | reproche (se hizo y no debía) | *You **shouldn't have said** that.* |
| **needn't have + participio** | se hizo algo innecesario | *I **needn't have brought** an umbrella.* |
| **didn't need to + verbo** | no era necesario (puede que no se hiciera) | *I **didn't need to bring** one.* |
| **could have + participio** | posibilidad no aprovechada / reproche suave | *You **could have helped**.* |
| **couldn't have + participio** | imposible | *I **couldn't have known**.* |
| **might / may have + participio** | posibilidad pasada | *She **might have forgotten**.* |
| **must have + participio** | deducción segura | *He **must have missed** the bus.* |
| **can't have + participio** | deducción negativa | *She **can't have left** yet.* |
| **would have + participio** | resultado hipotético | *I **would have gone** if I'd known.* |
**Needn't have vs didn't need to**
- *I needn't have taken an umbrella.* = lo cogí, pero no hacía falta.
- *I didn't need to take an umbrella.* = no era necesario (no sabemos si lo cogí).
- *I didn't have to wait.* = no tuve que esperar (no hubo obligación).
**Tono**
- *You should have told me* (crítica directa) · *You could have told me* (crítica suave) · *You might have told me!* (reproche irritado).
**Con -ing (acción en curso)**
- *She should have been working.* · *They must have been waiting.*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *I should have went.* → ✔ *I should have gone.*
- ✘ *You needn't to have come.* → ✔ *You needn't have come.*
- ✘ *I should of called.* → ✔ *I should have called.* (se escribe *have*, no *of*).
- ✘ *You must to have seen it.* → ✔ *You must have seen it.*
- ✘ *She mustn't have forgotten.* → ✔ *She can't have forgotten.*
**Ojo:** *ought to* lleva *to*; *should* no. *Needn't* (UK) = *don't need to* (US). En habla, *have* se reduce a /əv/ y suena como *of*.
Pronunciación: *should have* /ˈʃʊd əv/ · *ought to have* /ˈɔːt tə əv/ · *forecast* /ˈfɔːkɑːst/.
